IS : 10208 - 1982
1. S c o p e 1.1 Lays down the requirements for the following components of the diamond core drilling equipment: a) Drill rods and rod couplings; b) Casings, casing couplings, casing bits, casing shoebits, drive shoes and casing reaming shells; and c) Core barrels, core bits, core lifters, core lifter case and reaming shells. 1.2 It also covers the nomenclature, basic dimensions for drill rods, casings, core barrels and their related diamond set items for the various designs of the core drilling equipment. 1.3 The equipment covered by this standard are suitable for drilling holes from 30-200 mm diameter yielding cores of 18.5-165 mm diameter. 2. Nomenclature 2.1  Identification  Symbols -- For the identification of the equipment, the following symbols shall be used for various designs of the equipment:

It  shall  not  exceed  10  percent  of  the  nominal  wall  thickness  t.  The  eccentricity  is  calculated  as  follows: 

where  tmax  and  tmin  are  measured  values  in  the  same  section.  4.2  Straightness  --  Whert  measured  over  the  whole  length  of  the  tube  by  rolling  against  a  straight  edge,  the  maximum  deviation  shall  not  exceed  1  in  1  200.  5. 5.1.1 T h e s u i t a b l e m a t e r i a l for t h e m a n u f a c t u r e of v a r i o u s c o m p o n e n t s guidance: Rod couplings and adaptors is given b e l o w for

Steel designation 40Cr1Mo28 according to IS : 15701961 ' S c h e d u l e s for wrought steels for general engineering p u r p o s e s ' or equivalent which will meet the physical properties specified in 5.1 Steel designation C35IVIn75 or 40Cr1Mo28 according to IS : 1570-1961 or equivalent which will meet the physical properties specified in 5.1

Drill rods, c a s i n g s, casing couplings, core barrel Inner and outer tubes, reaming shells, core bits, core lifter case , casing show bits Core lifter

Steel designation 55Si2Mn90 or 40Cr1Mo28 according to IS : 1570-1961 or equivalent which will meet the physical properties specified in 5.1

5.1.2 If w e l d i n g is u s e d in p l a c e of u p s e t t i n g , t h e m e c h a n i c a l p r o p e r t i e s of t h e w e l d e d joint s h a l l c o n f o r m to v a l u e s specified in 5 . 1 . T h e d e s i g n of t h e w e l d e d joint is at t h e d i s c r e t i o n of the manufacturer. 6. D e s i g n a t i o n -- T h e c o m p o n e n t s of t h e d i a m o n d c o r e drilling e q u i p m e n t c o n f o r m i n g in all respects to this standard shall be designated by the commonly used name of the component, d e s i g n , t y p e o f c o r e b a r r e l a n d t h e identification symbol a n d t h e n u m b e r o f t h i s Indian S t a n d a r d . Example  1:  A 'W d e s i g n drill rod for h o l e of s i z e ' H' a n d h a v i n g an effective length of 1.5 m s h a l l be designated as: Drill rod HW -- 1.5 IS : 10208 Example  2:  h a v i n g an effective length of 3 m s h a l l be A 'X' d e s i g n c a s i n g for h o l e of s i z e ' E ' a n d designated as: C a s i n g EX -- 3.0 IS : 10208 Example  3:  R e a m i n g Shell -- W D e s i g n C a s i n g BW IS : 10208 Example  4:  A ' W F ' d e s i g n d o u b l e t u b e c o r e barrel for h o l e of s i z e  'U' a n d having c o r e barrel length of 3 m s h a l l be d e s i g n a t e d a s : D o u b l e T u b e C o r e Barrel UWF -- 3.0 IS : 10208 Example  5:  T h e inner t u b e o f ' W F ' d e s i g n d o u b l e t u b e c o r e b a r r e l for h o l e o f s i z e ' S ' a n d h a v i n g c o r e barrel length of 3 m s h a l l be d e s i g n a t e d a s : Inner T u b e -- WF D e s i g n D o u b l e T u b e C o r e Barrel S W F -- 3.0 IS : 10208 Example  6:  A s i n g l e t u b e c o r e barrel of ' W G ' d e s i g n a n d for h o l e of s i z e  'H' a n d having c o r e b a r r e l l e n g t h of 3 m s h a l l be d e s i g n a t e d a s : S i n g l e T u b e C o r e Barrel HWG -- 3.0 IS : 10208 Example  7:  A r e a m i n g s h e ll of t h e s i n g l e t u b e c o r e barrel of t h e ' W G ' d e s i g n for h o l e of s i z e ' B ' shall b e d e s i g n a t e d a s : R e a m i n g Shell -- WG D e s i g n S i n g l e T u b e C o r e Barrel BWG IS : 10208 8 A 'W' d e s i g n c a s i n g r e a m i n g s h e l l for h o l e of s i z e ' B ' s h a l l be d e s i g n a t e d a s :

General Requirements 7.1 Drill rods, inner tubes of double tube core barrels and single tube core barrel heads may be of welded construction but shall conform in all respects with the requirements of this standard. 7.2 All outer tubes of core barrels shall be chrome plated on outside to a length of 450 mm from the bottom end. The plating shall have a thickness of 0.1 mm minimum. 7.3 Unless specified by purchaser, blank core bit and blank reaming with core barrels. shell shall not be supplied

IS : 1 0 2 0 8 - 1 9 8 2 21.2  '  WT  '  Design  Double  Tube  Core  Barrel  (  for  RWT,  EWT  and  AWT  Sizes  )  21.2.1  Nomenclature  -- A typical assembly of double tube core barrel of RWT, EWT and AWT sizes is shown below:

Reference Number 1 or 1 2 3 4 5 6

Description Core bit bevel wall Core bit straight wall Core lifter Reaming shell Outer tube Inner tube Head-rigid type

21.2.1.1 No core lifter is used with straight walled bits. 21.2.1.2  'WT' design double tube core barrels of RWT, EWT and AWT sizes shall have lengths of 1 500 mm, 3 000 mm and 6 000 mm ( lengths refer to core capacity ). 21.2.1.3 Unless otherwise specified bevel wall core bit shall be supplied.

IS : 10208 - 1982 EXPLANATORY NOTE

The diamond core drilling equipment as specified in this standard are characterised by a series of hole sizes specifically designed for wide nesting, permitting relatively greater reduction in the hole diameters as the depth of the hole increases and employing relatively heavy casings between the hole sizes. In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been following: derived from the

ISO/DIS 3551/1,2 ' Diamond core drilling equipment -- System A: Part I Metric units ' issued by the International Organization for Standardization. BS : 4019 Part 1-1974 'Rotary core drilling equipment Part equipment' issued by the British Standards Institution. 1 Diamond core drilling

90
